meta.name: build-skills-index
meta.description: Scan SKILL.md files in .gaai/core/skills/ and .gaai/project/skills/, extract YAML frontmatter, and regenerate separate skills indices for each layer. Core index ships with the OSS framework; project index is project-specific.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描 skill 文件并自动重建分层索引
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要维护或发布 skills 索引
copy.tagline_en: Scan skill files and rebuild layered indices automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain or publish skills indices

howto.what: 扫描核心技能和项目技能文件夹中的SKILL.md文件，提取其YAML元数据，然后分别为每个文件夹生成一个索引文件，列出所有技能的名称、描述、ID等信息。
howto.when: 当你创建、修改或删除一个技能时自动触发，或者当你手动要求重建技能索引时执行。

say.text: 扫描所有技能，更新索引。
say.note: 重新生成核心和项目的技能索引文件。

say.text: 检查技能状态，重建索引。
say.note: 用于手动刷新技能目录。

howto.what_en: Scans SKILL.md files in core and project skill directories, extracts YAML frontmatter, and regenerates separate index files for each layer.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically when a skill is created, modified, or deleted, or when manually requested to rebuild the index.

say_en.text: Scan all skills and update the index.
say_en.note: Regenerates both core and project skill indices.

say_en.text: Check skill status and rebuild index.
say_en.note: For manual refresh of the skill catalog.
